```plato

    //==
    // # BarycentricCoordinate (barycentric / affine-combination lessons)
    //
    // Vertex binding U -> A, V -> B, W -> C (points.types.plato). Evaluate takes the
    // three triangle vertices explicitly, so it lives in points territory rather
    // than needing a Triangle type. Computed as A + V*(B - A) + W*(C - A), which
    // equals U*A + V*B + W*C when U + V + W = 1 and stays well-defined regardless.

    // The point at these weights on the triangle (a, b, c): the affine combination
    // U*a + V*b + W*c on the support plane. Vertex binding U->a, V->b, W->c.
    Evaluate(self: BarycentricCoordinate, a: Point2D, b: Point2D, c: Point2D): Point2D
        => a + a.Between(b) * self.V + a.Between(c) * self.W;
```
